title: Qwen3.6-27B compact-GDN value/recurrent in-place scratch rejection
repo_revision: working tree after 1f89a177b; candidate removed before commit
hardware: AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX / gfx1100 / HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 / PCI 0000:10:00.0 / sysfs card0 / 23.984375 GiB VRAM
hypothesis: The compact peer-wave32 recurrent kernel consumes each FP32 value element before publishing the same-index recurrent output, so an alias-safe in-place value/output ABI could remove one full-row plane without changing math.

candidate.change: Remove no-alias promises from compact recurrence value/output pointers, prove exact in-place output/state, and model recurrent_out as a view over prefill_value only for the gfx1100 Qwen3.6-27B compact-peer policy.

correctness.red: The planner kept distinct prefill_value/recurrent_out pointers and the compact kernel declared both pointers restrict.
correctness.green: The focused gfx1100 oracle passed with recurrent output overwriting the value buffer and matched separate-output BF16 output plus FP32 recurrent-state bits exactly.
correctness.source_lineage_check: python3 scripts/check_lineage.py --kind kernel --diff stat; known parent drift only, no code ported

protocol: Selector-unset package-default sole-T16 session, repeated token 9707, one discarded warmup plus three measured persistent reset/replays, bulk prefill, BF16 KV, HIP graph decode, 128 timed transitions, 5-ms whole-device VRAM sampling, shapes strictly serial.

same_tree_noalias_control_8192.purpose: Separate compiler qualifier effects from physical arena-layout effects.

diagnosis: The alias-safe kernel itself is not the loss: same-tree separate-output 8K improves 0.093% versus the retained baseline, and a counterbalanced M4096 complete prepare+recurrent+RMS leaf found in-place 1.275% faster. The full-row arena repack changes Q/K/scalar colors and regresses complete 8K prefill stably by 1.321% versus the same-tree no-alias control, overwhelming the 65.984-MiB whole-device saving.
decision: Reject and remove the kernel/planner/policy/test candidate. The user requirement forbids prefill regressions; do not retain the 66.5-MiB tracked / 65.984-MiB whole-device 8K saving at a 1.321% same-tree prefill cost. Keep the prior single-owner decode-scratch matrix as current.
